caseName: Arizona Copper Co. v. Arizona ex rel. Webster
caseNameFull: Arizona Copper Company, Ltd., in Error v. The State of Arizona at the Relation of and to the use of John M. Webster, Treasurer and ex officio Tax Collector in and for the County of Greenlee, State of Arizona
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Arizona.
attorneys: Mr. Walter Bennett for the plaintiff in error. Mr. George J. Stoneman and Mr. Reese M. Ling for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Eustis v. Bolles, 150 U. S. 361; Yazoo & Miss. V. R. R. v. Brewer, 231 U. S. 245; Holden Land Co. v. Interstate Trading Co., 233 U. S. 536.
